automatic_filename.grammar: exact literal 'Advanced Search(Service Request)' + exactly 14 ASCII digits YYYYMMDDHHMMSS + '.xlsx'
automatic_filename.matching: case-sensitive anchored full filename; no trim, fuzzy match, substring family guess, wildcard family guess or collision suffix

timestamp.validation: strict Gregorian YYYYMMDDHHMMSS; malformed date/time is ineligible
timestamp.meaning: automatic source-population chronology only; never an SR Report Date, Last Update, SLA instant or Objective scheduling instant

rules: automatic discovery inspects only direct stable regular non-reparse files in the configured Advanced Search inbox
newest selected candidate is validated; invalid newest candidate fails visibly and automatic discovery never falls back to an older workbook
filesystem mtime, collision-like suffixes and workbook internal timestamps never replace the embedded automatic chronology

manual_selection.rule: operator may explicitly select one local .xlsx outside the configured inbox; the path still passes the shared XLSX/path/reparse/stability security boundary
manual_selection.filename: manual preview may inspect a safe file whose physical name does not match automatic grammar
manual_selection.publication_chronology: ordinary publication/checkpoint comparison requires a usable supported Advanced Search population chronology. In Beta 1.0 the supported chronology is the valid embedded ADVANCED_SEARCH_SR_V1 filename timestamp; manual input lacking it remains SOURCE_CHRONOLOGY_UNRESOLVED and cannot publish authoritative population/checkpoint/domain acceptance.
prohibitions: row Last Update is not population chronology

operational_time_semantics.text_grammar: exact ASCII Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD followed by one literal 'T' or one ASCII space, HH:MM:SS, optional fractional seconds of 1..6 ASCII digits, then optional uppercase 'Z' or signed numeric offset +/-HH:MM; no locale dates, slash dates, timezone abbreviations, lowercase z, omitted seconds or offset without colon
operational_time_semantics.calendar_validation: year 0001..9999; month/day/hour/minute/second and explicit numeric offset must form a valid datetime; leap seconds are unsupported
operational_time_semantics.offset_present: uppercase Z means UTC; otherwise use the exact explicit signed numeric offset
operational_time_semantics.fractional_second_rule: fractional seconds are source precision only; resolve the instant first, normalize to UTC, then discard the fractional remainder without rounding or carry so persisted authority is the containing UTC whole second
operational_time_semantics.excel_numeric_rule: a numeric XLSX value is an instant only when openpyxl in the mandated semantic reader mode resolves that registered temporal cell through the workbook's supported 1900/1904 date system and date/time style to a Python datetime/date value; a bare numeric value that is not date-resolved is malformed temporal evidence, and formula cached values are never accepted
operational_time_semantics.storage: canonical UTC whole-second instant represented as nonnegative Unix seconds; pre-1970 resolved instants are malformed because the shared persisted instant contract is int64>=0
operational_time_semantics.scope: the same grammar applies to every Advanced Search registered instant field, active or deferred
operational_time_semantics.rule: operational cell timestamps remain distinct from Asia/Shanghai filename chronology and from the selectable Objective timezone

duration_semantics.text_grammar: after surrounding spreadsheet-whitespace trimming, an optional leading '+' followed by either ASCII digits with optional '.' and one or more fractional ASCII digits, or '.' followed by one or more ASCII digits; exponent notation, sign '-', commas, locale separators, unit suffixes, NaN and Infinity are unsupported
duration_semantics.numeric_cells: finite nonnegative XLSX numeric cells are interpreted as decimal days using their deterministic semantic numeric value; booleans and date/time-valued cells are not durations
duration_semantics.conversion: convert with Decimal arithmetic as source_days * exactly 86400 seconds, then quantize to exactly one whole second using IEEE decimal ROUND_HALF_EVEN
duration_semantics.range: the resulting integer duration must be between 0 and 9223372036854775807 inclusive; overflow/nonfinite/negative/malformed input is malformed field evidence and never clamps
duration_semantics.blank: a present blank Suspension Duration cell is usable source-reported exact integer zero seconds
duration_semantics.missing_column: an absent Suspension Duration semantic header is missing coverage and does not manufacture zero evidence
duration_semantics.authority: the integer whole-second result is the normalized logical value and accepted cumulative source-reported suspension authority; raw decimal days are provenance only and are never accumulated or inferred by SOMA

discarded_fields.rule: always discarded after staging security/header classification; never retained as SourceObservation field and never drives Contract, Product Line, CPL, product family, Network Element, Device Reference, SLA or Inventory authority

rules: SRNo is the only universally required usable row identity
missing optional-active/deferred headers produce coverage findings and never clear prior accepted values
column order is irrelevant; duplicate semantic headers block workbook interpretation
unregistered headers are discarded after bounded security scanning and do not enter logical fingerprint or reconciliation

controlled_vocabularies.unknown_nonblank: warning evidence only; cannot overwrite a previously recognized canonical status

controlled_vocabularies.rule: classify only through ADVANCED_SEARCH_SEVERITY_V1 after the registry normalization; preserve the registry canonical source spelling as controlled source evidence and expose only its exact resolved_severity token through the accepted LLD-03/LLD-04 SLA input boundary
controlled_vocabularies.unknown_nonblank: warning evidence only; preserve prior recognized severity and remain unresolved for SLA authority
controlled_vocabularies.blank: missing/unresolved source evidence; preserve prior recognized severity and never supply a default
prohibitions: no direct reuse of arbitrary source spelling as an LLD-06 severity token

field_semantics: Current Handler is source-owned current-assignment text. A usable newer accepted observation may change it; an accepted blank may clear the source-assignment display only. It never creates competing locally authoritative handler text.
Current Handler and Customer Contact may seed reviewed Contact reconciliation but never silently create, merge, select or re-affiliate a Contact.
Customer Account Code is preferred Customer Organization matching evidence; labels are descriptive candidate evidence only.
Suspend Planned End Date represents active suspension context only when accepted status is Customer Agreed Suspend and the end is a valid future instant under the consuming as-of context.

Suspension Duration is cumulative source-reported decimal days normalized once to whole duration_seconds under duration_semantics and is never inferred between workbooks. Blank parses as source-reported exact zero; a new blank/zero contradicting accepted nonzero evidence requires review before erasure.
ResolveBy and Resolve By Suspend are retained as future-use provenance only and cannot drive Beta 1.0 SLA/risk/expiration/notification/workflow.
evolution: Any filename/header/timezone/vocabulary/field-authority/value-parsing grammar change creates a new immutable profile or registry version after this pre-implementation V1 closure; historical ImportRuns preserve the exact versions used.
